verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt file at the API dashboard (HTTP 200) describing the Brave Search API for LLM readers. Docs and API-reference pages are also served as markdown (index.html.md URLs), and a Skills resource targets coding agents such as Claude Code and Cursor. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found (all candidate paths returned 404), and the /app/documentation.md markdown variant returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
